selection_policy: Download the complete official compressed archive only on 18.77, verify whole size+official MD5, compute SHA256, then selectively extract six Pubmed regular files. Extract no other dataset.
download_guards: Linux only, matching operator-supplied target hostname, explicit 18.77 attestation before networking
Runtime repo and phase are pinned to the exact 18.77 paths; script and every output, partial archive, raw archive and receipt must stay inside the pinned phase
Fresh output destination; no overwrite, resume, symlink/hardlink extraction, extractall, path traversal or other-dataset extraction
Current server-fetched official metadata must still match reviewed file key, size and checksum
No torch/numpy/scientific imports or pickle loading; split text counts and safe NPY header inspection only
unknowns_after_downloader: Feature key, shape/dtype and actual donor
Pool payload endpoint ranges, filtering and association to positive row order
custody_contract: Plain withheld_inputs paths excluded from the TRAIN/VALID adapter, explicit config/checkpoint freeze, then once-only final evaluator. Existing filesystem access remains; no permission, account, namespace, mount or server configuration changes are made or required.
